sources.possible_contamination: Contains case prompts and ground-truth findings.
sources.mitigation: Evaluation builds a fresh PreflightRequest containing only prompt and neutral generation fields. Labels, case IDs, slices, and expected findings are never passed to the SemanticProvider interface.

sources.possible_contamination: Constructs findings from benchmark labels and must never be reused as LIVE_SEMANTIC.
sources.mitigation: Gate 2 uses a separate script, manifest, report namespace, and single real provider. POLICY_REPLAY and LIVE_SEMANTIC remain separate report sections.

sources.possible_contamination: Risk tags could disclose expected failure categories if the whole seed record reached the provider.
sources.mitigation: Gate 2 dataset copies prompt text before the first run and contains no legacy risk-tag field. The live runner does not load prompt_case_seed_v1.

sources.source: failure pattern catalog and preflight rubric
sources.possible_contamination: Pattern descriptions can resemble expected semantic findings.
sources.mitigation: No tools or patterns are available during semantic detection. Pattern retrieval may run only after the model has returned findings and is not used by the finding matcher.

sources.possible_contamination: Lists general categories such as ambiguity and continuity.
sources.mitigation: The prompt contains no case ID, benchmark text, expected evidence span, finding description, or case-specific example. Generic task categories are part of the public task contract.

sources.possible_contamination: Synthetic test prompts could become few-shot answers if embedded in the runtime prompt.
sources.mitigation: Runtime prompts contain no few-shot examples. Tests exercise providers through injected boundary implementations and are not imported by production runtime.
